news.headline: Ukrainian drone strikes kill at least 3, wound 5 in Moscow region
news.summary: Drone attacks killed at least three people and injured five others in the Moscow region, governor Andrey Vorobyov said on Telegram Monday. Ukraine has been intensifying its strikes on Russia's energy targets in response to Moscow's barrages.

news.headline: Fire in Bangkok Bar Leaves at Least 27 Dead
news.summary: The fast-moving blaze sent people fleeing toward the bathrooms to hide, officials said. Their bodies were found there, raising questions about safety standards.
